notes: Algorithm measured (kernel least-squares fit on the AE refs, then a bit-exact numpy emulation): per RGB channel on the premultiplied colour, out = clamp(128 + Contrast/100 * (S(p+v) - S(p-v)), 0, 255) * alpha/255, alpha unchanged; v = Relief * (sin Direction, -cos Direction) px (0 deg = up, clockwise); S = AE 8 bpc bilinear sample (weights rounded to 1/256, integer sum, rounded half up to 8 bits), transparent outside the layer (no edge repeat). Colours are NOT desaturated (AE's Emboss works per channel). Blend With Original = linear mix with the untouched premultiplied layer (not covered by the visible refs). Not reproduced: Compositing Options (AE 5: effect opacity / effect masks); the rounding of Contrast/100 * D when it is fractional (e.g. Contrast 150) is unknown, the shader leaves it to the 8-bit output (<= 1 LSB); in 16/32 bpc AE projects the samples are not quantized to 8 bits (<= 1 LSB of D times Contrast/100). Remaining offline mismatches are 1 LSB of D on ~0.1 % of the pixels (AE fixed-point details). Rive's canvas render of the source differs from the PNG by 1 LSB on ~1 % of the pixels on some runs (run-to-run), which moves D by 1.
